items.description: Painting disturbed wall area and closing wall opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening needed to reach the leaking pipe is covered under 7.1.7(a); a small patch and repaint, upper customary price.
One travel charge per contractor per invoice under 7.1.7(f); the first charge is covered at the prior level.
Consumable installation material is covered under 7.1.7(c).
Replacement pipe section for the failed cold water line is covered under 7.1.7(c).
Insulation of the repaired section is covered under 7.1.7(c); reference cases price it at roughly 18 per piece.
Trade labour at customary rates is covered under 7.1.7(g); 1 hour at about 70.
The contractor's own diagnostic and measuring devices are business outlay, not a repair cost, under 7.1.8(b).
Labour is covered under 7.1.7(g); price prior gives about 47 per hour, so 9 h is about 425.
Under 7.1.7(f) only the first travel charge per contractor invoice is indemnified, so this second charge is not.
Drying before closing the wall and equipment deployment are covered once per drying operation under 7.1.7(b) and (e).
The contractor's own blades and tools are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Fittings needed to connect the repaired pipe section are covered under 7.1.7(c).
The same pipe item is invoiced twice for one 1 m repair; only the first charge is indemnified under 7.1.8(c) and (d).
The 1 m repaired section is already insulated under line 5, so this is a second insulation charge for the same item under 7.1.8(c) and (d).
This is an identical repeat of line 8 for a small repair; the duplicate is not indemnified under 7.1.8(c) and 7.1.7(g).
